description: This source file contains platform-specific upgrade functions for Mikrotik devices using OpenWrt's firmware upgrade framework. It includes functions to check image validity, perform NAND upgrades, and handle different device models.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks if the firmware image is valid; always returns success.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_mikrotik_nand
methods.description: Performs the NAND upgrade process for Mikrotik devices, extracting the kernel from the firmware image and flashing it via yafut.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Determines the device model and performs an appropriate firmware upgrade, either NAND or initramfs.
